get.summary:
The actual content behind a DownloadAuthorization.url. Not part of the frozen OpenAPI
paths (that contract only specifies the opaque `url` string) — an internal signed-delivery
implementation route. Attachments are private: this route requires the same Bearer access
token as every other endpoint (global AuthGuard; no @Public()). The signed query
parameters bind the URL to the caller it was issued to (see download-token.util.ts); a
different authenticated caller presenting someone else's URL gets a plain 404, same as any
invalid, tampered or expired token, so a probing client learns nothing about which case
applies. Rate limited per remote IP (never a client-supplied header) independently of the
per-user upload/authorization-issuance limits.

info.title: WST API — Final (v4)
info.description:
**Final — contract v4.** This page lists only the endpoints that are finished and verified against the
requirements: signing in and sessions, user accounts, roles and organizational scopes, health,
customers, vehicles, bays, service types, technician profiles, operating hours, the full job-card
workflow (stages, customer approvals, labor, quality checks, work items), in-app notifications,
attachments, the audit log, inventory, purchasing (vendors, purchase orders, approvals, goods
receipts, closing an undelivered remainder), invoices (sublet cost, discount, issue, payment) and
the System Administrator's settings (tax rate, late-data grace period). Training, dashboards,
exports and predictions are not yet final. They will not change without a new contract version.
The full, still-evolving API is at `/api/docs`.

**Changed since v3:** the customer-approval scope `SUBLET` no longer exists (approvals are
`INITIAL_WORK` or `ADDITIONAL_WORK` only, D4) — sublet cost is added directly to a DRAFT
invoice by the Service Advisor (`POST /invoices/{invoiceId}/sublet-costs`, UC-08).

Backend API for the WST Workshop Management & Student Practical Training system.

**Base path:** every endpoint is under `/api/v1`.

**Signing in**
1. `POST /api/v1/auth/login` with `{ "email", "password" }` returns an `accessToken` (short-lived) and a `refreshToken`.
2. Send `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>` on every other call (the **Authorize** button above does this here).
3. When the access token expires, `POST /api/v1/auth/refresh` with the refresh token returns a new pair; each refresh token works once.
4. `POST /api/v1/auth/logout` ends the session immediately.
5. A new account, or one whose password an administrator reset, must first call `POST /api/v1/auth/change-password`; until then every other endpoint answers **403 PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED** (only change-password, logout and `GET /auth/me` work).

**Who may call what:** each operation lists its **Allowed roles**. Any other role gets **403 FORBIDDEN**. Records outside the caller's organizational units, or outside what its role may see, answer **404** as if they did not exist.

**Errors** always have the same shape: `{ "code", "message", "requestId", "details"? }` — show `message` to users, branch on `code`, and quote `requestId` when reporting a problem.

**Lists** accept `page` and `pageSize` and return `{ items, page: { page, pageSize, totalItems, totalPages } }`.

studentId.description: Present only when this account is linked to a student record.
Present only when this account is linked to a student record.

quantity.description: Decimal string (hours for labor, units for parts).

sourceType.description: Every line comes from a recorded source — never typed by hand (D5).

sourceId.description: The labor entry / part issue / sublet entry this line comes from.

value.description: A percentage (PERCENT) or an amount in the invoice currency (AMOUNT), as a decimal string.

taxRatePercent.description: The rate this invoice was calculated with.

invoiceNumber.description: Assigned when the invoice is issued (finalized); absent on a DRAFT.

status.description: DRAFT → ISSUED (finalized, locked) → PAID; VOID ends it.

referenceId.description: Omitted for a JOB entry when the caller cannot read jobs.

fromStage.description: Absent on the first entry (the job was opened in RECEIVED).

reason.description: e.g. the quality-check failure notes, or why the initial scope was declined/withdrawn (D29).

eventType.description: The D50 event that is waiting on the recipient.

entityType.description: The kind of record the notification is about (e.g. JOB_CARD, JOB_APPROVAL, STOCK_ADJUSTMENT).

entityId.description: The id of that record — open it with the matching GET endpoint.

laborHourlyRate.description: Only for a caller holding service-types.manage.

version.description: Only for a caller holding service-types.manage.

createdAt.description: Only for a caller holding service-types.manage.

updatedAt.description: Only for a caller holding service-types.manage.

createdBy.description: Only for a caller holding service-types.manage.

updatedBy.description: Only for a caller holding service-types.manage.

estimatedAmount.description: The amount quoted to the customer (D36(b)); always present once APPROVED.

workItemIds.description: Initial-work items this approval covers (always empty for ADDITIONAL_WORK — its item is added from the approval afterwards, D27).

approvedByName.description: Who gave the decision on the customer side.

recordedBy.description: The Service Advisor who recorded the decision.

notes.description: Decision notes; always present on a REJECTED approval (the reason, D30).

withdrawnAt.description: D29: set when an approved initial scope was withdrawn.

notes.description: Required when the decision is REJECTED — the reason for the rejection (D30).

estimatedAmount.description:
D36(b): the estimated amount for the approved scope. Required on an APPROVED decision unless
an amount was already supplied when the approval was created; ignored on a REJECTED decision.

result.description: PASSED moves the job to READY (and drafts the invoice); FAILED returns it to IN_PROGRESS.

recordedAt.description: When it was recorded in the system (D36(f)).

performedAt.description:
D36(f): when the check actually happened, if it is being recorded later. Defaults to now;
may not be in the future. The time it was recorded is always stored separately.

hourlyRate.description: The labor rate copied onto the entry (D33). Only for roles holding inventory.cost.read — never the Technician (D45).

status.description: UNLINKED right after upload — link it to its record within 24 hours or it expires.

url.description: Short-lived signed URL, bound to the caller. GET it with the same Bearer token to receive the file bytes.

before.description: Value before the change (any JSON type).

after.description: Value after the change (any JSON type).

actorUserId.description: Absent for a system action (e.g. a scheduled retention sweep).

sellingPrice.description: Only for roles holding inventory.cost.read — never the Technician (D45).

averageCost.description: Computed from goods receipts, never typed (D34). Only for roles holding inventory.cost.read (D45).

belowMinimum.description: The stock alert: on-hand is at or below the minimum level.

reconciled.description: True when every balance equals the sum of its stock movements.

consumedQuantity.description: How much of the reservation later issues consumed.

reservationId.description: The reservation this issue consumed, if any.

unitPrice.description: Selling-price snapshot (D33). Only for roles holding inventory.cost.read (D45).

unitCost.description: Average-cost snapshot (D33). Only for roles holding inventory.cost.read (D45).

partIssueStatus.description: The part issue's status after this reversal.

systemQuantity.description: On-hand captured by the system at recording time — never typed (D36(e)).

countedAt.description:
D36(f): when the physical count happened, if recorded later than it was taken. Defaults to
now; may not be in the future. The time it was recorded (recordedAt) is always stored
separately and is never client-supplied.

systemQuantity.description: On-hand captured by the system when the count was recorded.

quantityDelta.description: Derived from the stock count: countedQuantity − systemQuantity.

decisionReason.description: Always present on a REJECTED adjustment (D30).

stockMovementId.description: The single stock movement an approval created (D39).

stockCountId.description: Absent only on adjustments recorded before stock counts existed.

minimumTotal.description: POs whose total is at or above this need requiredApprovals approvals.

quantityAccepted.description: Cumulative accepted quantity across all receipts (never above ordered).

remainderClosedAt.description: UC-10B: set once the undelivered remainder was closed.

status.description: RECEIVED = complete (every line received or its remainder closed). CANCELLED is never produced by the API.

total.description: Sum of ordered quantity × unit cost — decides the approval threshold (D40(a)).

requiredApprovals.description: Fixed at submission; null while DRAFT.

stockMovementId.description: The stock movement the accepted quantity created (none when 0 accepted).

lateGracePeriodMinutes.description: A record arriving later than this after its event counts as "late" (D36(f)).

userId.description: A UUID to link an account, or null to unlink the currently linked account.

requestId.description: Quote this when reporting a problem.
